play_overview: [[Niru]] stores an ally soul at battle start so they **keep fighting in spirit form** after a fatal blow, preserving output from a key carry. She strikes the weakest foe for **bonus damage at low HP**, drains enemy HP to **heal the weakest ally**, and grows battle max HP to stay relevant on the field. Her opening ultimate **costs no energy**, letting the spirit safeguard trigger immediately. Attacks also briefly **block target healing**, adding soft anti-sustain on her pressure target. She is a **battle-start safety net** for one ally with drain-based sustain for the team. Without a **worthy soul target** or fights that end before spirit triggers, much of her protection sits idle.
counter_overview: [[Niru]]'s PVP threat is a **battle-start ultimate** that stores an ally soul so they keep fighting in **spirit form** after a fatal blow, plus drain heals into the weakest ally and brief heal-block on her pressure target. Her free opener can **soak a [[Lily May]] cancel** meant for another ultimate; pair [[Pandora]] with [[Lily May]] when you need a second wind-up interrupt. Delete the **soul-bound carry** before the fatal blow with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or finish them through the spirit window with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]]. Race your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] so spirit never matters.
